# Lukas Golino

> Dr Lukas Golino is a physicist at CERN and an independent game developer. This is his personal site: writings, research, travels, and his open-source game-development tools and games.

## Open-source game-development tools (free, MIT, for AI agents and Godot 4)

- [PAGAN](https://pagan.top/): pixel art, sprites and tilesets written as text by an AI agent
- [SEGAN](https://segan.top/): game sound effects and music written as text by an AI agent
- [KILN](https://kiln3d.dev/): stylised 3D game models written as text by an AI agent

## Games

- [Age of Boom](https://ageofboom.online/): top-down pixel-art naval combat, online and co-op
- [LOOSE!](https://loosegame.com/): comedic medieval siege game where you are the arrow
- [NEXT TOKEN](https://next-token.dev/): free browser game about what it is like to be a language model
